game.name: Dead or Alive : Xtreme 2 (Japan, Asia)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko,Pl)
game.desc: Friends of the two-piece, good evening! Dead or Alive: Xtreme 2 on Xbox 360 showcases the buxom ladies of the series. Gathered once again on Zack's island, the busty fighters will compete in beach volleyball matches and jet-ski races before offering themselves various trinkets and other sexy accessories. No need to say, it smells like summer.
